items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: The name 'Lloyd' is mentioned by the interviewer as his own name ('Lloyd Enneagram') and in the context of checking the recording equipment. The interviewee does not mention Lloyd, nor does the interviewer ask the interviewee about a relationship with Lloyd.

ctx.x: Yeah, what's your name, man? Lloyd. Lloyd Enneagram. And what's your name, Barry? My name's Dick Allen. And what's your name, man? Thomas. Thomas. Okay, and this is June the 17th, 1969. I hope the machine's working. I'm going to check it now.

Tom, I'll tell you, I'm going to start the interview a little later. I saw a friend of yours today, Emile Barnes. We just saw him this morning. Yeah. Man, I seen Emile Barnes. When did you first start working with him? Can you remember?
